data.overview: After a young man is killed during an attempted assault, a rebellious girl with an alibi is blamed and sent to a convent school for troubled teenagers. She clashes with the strict sisters while her closest friend spirals into a dangerous obsession with a rising singer, and their families chase answers outside the school gates.
data.tagline: What happens when youthful rebels go bad?
data.title: Trouble at Saint Agnes
